items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: And it'd make them at all, practically all in Larry's band.

ctx.x: Not Fats, no. Not Fats, William Houston. And everything would come out on the juice box that those people go for. Well, they'd write, put on paper. And it was pretty close on that. And it'd make them at all, practically all in Larry's band. Larry, big band. And I was doing all good, all right myself. Mm-hmm. Long in that number.
I just about run out of questions unless there's something special you want to add.
